label: GO step, strongly choosing a2, early in the episode (after a common transition)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), and essentially only when the agent is about to choose a2: model_act == 2 covers 99.98% of mass, and it never fires with a1 chosen. It also needs a strong a2 preference (choice logit < -4.4 holds 99% of mass) and is confined to the early episode: trials 0-29 hold about 80% of mass, it is rare after trial 30, and it never fires after trial 60. That makes it common in episodes that start with S2 good. It is suppressed after a rare transition on the previous trial (rate 0.9% vs 3.5% after common). Recorded predicate: GO & choice < -4.44 & ep_trial < 30 & prev_common != 0 (dev P 0.63, R 0.74, F1 0.68, mass recall 0.76). The simpler GO & model_act == 2 & ep_trial < 30 gives F1 0.62. Magnitude: the top activation quartile is almost all after an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward == 0 covers 98% of top-quartile steps), so the largest activations are repeated a2 choices after a common-unrewarded S2 visit early on. It does not fire at D1 or D2, on a1 choices, or late in the episode. The ep_trial dependence suggests a slow drift in the hidden state rather than an observed input. It uses only the agent's own upcoming choice and observed history, no future variables.
